title: MOVE and DISPLAY Basics
learning_objectives: Recognize where variables are declared in WORKING-STORAGE
Explain what MOVE does in a simple assignment
Predict what a DISPLAY statement prints after a MOVE
snippet:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. HELLOMOVE.

       DATA DIVISION.
       WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
       01 CUSTOMER-NAME PIC X(10) VALUE 'ALICE'.
       01 OUTPUT-NAME   PIC X(10).

       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           MOVE CUSTOMER-NAME TO OUTPUT-NAME
           DISPLAY OUTPUT-NAME
           STOP RUN.

practice_question.prompt: Which statement copies the value from one COBOL variable into another?

timed_task.prompt: After the snippet runs, what is most likely printed?

pre_test.prompt: In COBOL, where are simple variables commonly declared?

post_test.prompt: What is the main purpose of the line MOVE CUSTOMER-NAME TO OUTPUT-NAME?

choices.B: It copies a value into OUTPUT-NAME

post_test.prompt: Which variable is sent to the screen by DISPLAY OUTPUT-NAME?
